description: This file contains assembly language routines for an interrupt service routine (ISR) handler specifically for the AT91RM9200 microcontroller. It includes code for saving and restoring CPU context, interacting with the Advanced Interrupt Controller (AIC), and managing CPU modes during interrupt handling.

methods.name: AT91F_ST_ASM_HANDLER
methods.description: Assembly routine for handling an interrupt, saving context, switching modes, jumping to a C handler, and restoring context.
